battle.name: 八字軍
battle.theater: 河北西路磁州太行山區
battle.brief: 建炎元年（1127）九月，河北西路招撫使張所命都統制王彥率岳飛等七千人北渡黃河，進攻金人控制的燕雲十六州與河北。義軍將士面刺「赤心報國，誓殺金賊」八字，故名八字軍。卡面的配重投石車不在義軍手中，它屬金軍攻城序列，與撞車、雲梯並列，專門用來對付太行山寨與河北城寨的夯土牆。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的表面上是金與宋，暗裡較量的卻是三方：女真人建立的金朝、趙構南渡後的南宋，以及金人扶植的漢人傀儡政權大齊。靖康二年（1127）正月金軍攻破汴京，北宋覆亡；四月徽宗、欽宗二帝連同宗室、百官、匠戶被挾北去，河北、山東、中原一時失去全部行政秩序。金人依《海上之盟》取得燕雲十六州後，在燕京、雲中、真定一帶設招討司與軍鎮，把河北變成騎兵的後方與糧秣供應地，留在當地的官軍與衙門卻全部崩解。南宋建炎元年五月趙構即位於南京應天府，隨即南遷揚州、鎮江、臨安，一路被金軍追趕，北方故土完全失控。就在這片真空裡，燕雲十六州與河北各州縣的農民、獵戶、逃戶、殘兵與被金人收編的漢人軍戶各自武裝，以在面頰刺上「赤心報國，誓殺金賊」八個字立誓，結成義軍，合稱八字軍。八字軍起初不屬任何一方，既不受南渡朝廷節制，也不接受金人招撫，靠太行山地勢與民間網絡自生自滅。建炎元年九月河北西路招撫使張所調兵北渡，它才第一次被捲入兩國之間的正面戰事；建炎二年張所被罷官流放、招撫司裁撤後，隊伍又回到游擊與半招安的灰色地帶。及至金人立劉豫為齊帝、用漢人組軍鎮壓河北，大齊軍與八字軍在河北的零星衝突同樣構成這場戰爭的另一條戰線。
countriesEn: On the surface the war was fought between Jin and Song, but beneath it ran a three-way contest: the Jurchen Jin, the Southern Song of Zhao Gou that had fled south, and the Han Chinese puppet regime of Great Qi propped up by the Jin. In the first month of Jingkang 2 (1127) the Jin army broke into Bianjing and the Northern Song ceased to exist; in the fourth month the emperors Huizong and Qinzong were carried off north together with the imperial clan, the ministers and the craftsmen, and Hebei, Shandong and the central plain were suddenly left without any administration at all. Having obtained the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun under the terms of the Maritime Covenant, the Jin set up recruitment offices and garrisons around Yanjing, Yunzhong and Zhending, turning Hebei into the rear of their cavalry and the source of their supply, while every Song office and officer in the region simply fell apart. In May of Jianyan 1 the Southern Song was proclaimed by Zhao Gou at Yingtian Prefecture, and then shuffled south through Yangzhou, Runzhou and finally Lin'an, chased even by the Jin fleet, so that the old northern lands were left entirely without control. Into that vacuum the peasants, hunters, deserters, leftover soldiers and Jin-enrolled Han military households of Yanyun and the Hebei prefectures armed themselves, swore themselves in by tattooing the eight characters '赤心報國，誓殺金賊' on their faces, and formed the volunteer bands collectively called the Eight-Character Army. At the outset it belonged to no one: it accepted neither the discipline of the southern court nor Jin pacification, and survived on the terrain of the Taihang Mountains and on a peasant network of its own. Only in the ninth month of Jianyan 1 did Zhang Suo, the Pacification Commissioner of Hebei West Circuit, pull it into an open war by dispatching troops north across the Yellow River; after Zhang Suo was dismissed and exiled in the following year and his office abolished, the force slid back into the grey zone between guerrilla war and half-hearted pacification. Later, when the Jin enthroned Liu Yu as emperor of Qi and fielded Han Chinese troops to hold down the north, the clashes between that Qi army and the Eight-Character Army in Hebei formed yet another front of the same war.
people: 真正決定這場戰爭走向的，是幾個把散民變成軍隊的人。河北西路招撫使張所是第一個：他在建炎元年把流落南下的河北義軍重整為招撫司，並命都統制王彥率岳飛等七千人北渡黃河。張所很快被朝廷罷官流放，河北西路招撫司隨之裁撤，他留下的編制卻成了八字軍的骨架。都統制王彥字子才是這支部隊的靈魂：渡河初戰失利，他收攏散卒與河北民眾於敗逃途中重新編組，把數千人的隊伍擴成超過十萬人的義軍，並以太行山為根據地長期與金人周旋。岳飛是王彥麾下最出色的將領，也是八字軍脫離純義軍軌道、成為宋軍骨幹的關鍵人物；北渡時他與王彥意見不合而脫隊，轉投東京留守宗澤，後來以八百人破敵、屢收失地，終成岳家軍的核心。金人一邊則以完顏宗弼（兀朮）等宿將反覆掃蕩太行，粘罕（完顏宗昌）坐鎮河北指揮軍事。建炎二年宗澤病逝、張所已去，南宋在河北再無統一指揮，八字軍各部自此分屬張俊、劉錫、岳飛等將領，遂有順昌之戰中劉錫以五千人破金軍十萬的戰果。
peopleEn: The men who decided how this war turned were those who turned a mass of villagers into an army. Zhang Suo, Pacification Commissioner of Hebei West Circuit, was the first: in Jianyan 1 he reorganised the Hebei volunteers who had drifted south into a formal recruitment office and ordered the Commander Wang Yan to lead Yue Fei and seven thousand men north across the Yellow River. Zhang Suo was dismissed and exiled by the court soon afterwards and the recruitment office was abolished with him, but the organisation he had left behind became the skeleton of the Eight-Character Army. Commander Wang Yan, courtesy name Zicai, was the soul of the force: after the first crossing was defeated he gathered scattered soldiers and the people of Hebei along the line of retreat, reorganised them, and expanded a few thousand men into a host of more than one hundred thousand, using the Taihang Mountains as a base for long campaigns against the Jin. Yue Fei was the finest of Wang Yan's commanders and the key figure through whom the Eight-Character Army left the path of pure insurgency and became the backbone of the Song army; disagreeing with Wang Yan over the march, he broke away and joined the Song court's Resident of the Eastern Capital, Zong Ze, and after that defeated the enemy with eight hundred men and recovered lost ground repeatedly, until he stood at the core of the Yue family army. On the Jin side, veteran commanders such as Wanyan Zongbi, known as Wuzhu, repeatedly swept the Taihang range, while Nahan, Wanyan Zongchang, directed operations from Hebei. In the seventh month of Jianyan 2 Zong Ze died of illness and Zhang Suo was already gone, so that the Southern Song had no unified command left in Hebei. From then on the units of the Eight-Character Army were split among commanders such as Zhang Jun, Liu Qi and Yue Fei, and that is how the battle of Shunchang came to be fought, with Liu Qi routing a hundred thousand Jin troops with five thousand men.
kits: 八字軍是一支由農民、獵戶、殘兵、逃戶拼成的武裝，裝備極不統一，多數人只有一支舊弓、數十支竹箭、一把朴刀或削尖的竹槍，靠布衣、藤甲甚至羊皮抵擋箭矢，馬匹少得可憐，轉戰多靠步行與借來的坐騎。它在戰鬥中真正大量使用的是弓箭、朴刀、長槍與投擲用的礪石；面上刺字之後，同袍之間憑臉上的八字相認，這本身就是最原始的識別與誓約手段。配重投石車在這場戰爭裡的位置比較特殊：它不是民間義軍能自力打造的攻城重器，卻在金軍的裝備序列中與撞車、雲梯並列。河北的城寨多為夯土牆與土堡，配重長臂可以把石塊甩進寨牆，砸傷守軍、壓塌屋舍，也可以拋射炭火與燃燒的薪束。攻守之間，金人用配重投石車對付依山而建的太行山寨，山中的義軍則以自製的杠桿、皮兜做簡單拋石，甚至靠人工擲擲礪石，抵抗遠程壓制。順昌之戰時，金軍攻城仍備拋石與撞車，劉錫的守軍則以霹靂炮、毒箭與長槍應對，並以煙霧與鼓噪擾亂敵陣。
kitsEn: The Eight-Character Army was a force patched together from peasants, hunters, soldiers of the broken Northern Song army and runaway households, and its equipment was extremely uneven: most men had an old bow, a few dozen bamboo arrows, a broad dao or a spear sharpened from bamboo, and protected themselves with cloth coats, rattan armour or even goatskin, while horses were so scarce that movement relied on walking and on mounts borrowed from others. What it really used in combat were bows, broad blades, long spears and hand-thrown stones; and once the men had tattooed their faces, comrades recognised each other by the eight characters on the skin, which was in itself the most primitive badge of identity and oath. The counterweight trebuchet occupied a peculiar place in this war: it was not a heavy siege engine that a village militia could build for itself, yet it stood in the Jin order of battle beside battering rams and scaling ladders. The castles and stockades of Hebei were mostly rammed-earth walls and turf forts, and a long counterweighted arm could fling a stone over the wall to crush defenders and bring down roofs, or lob charcoal and burning bundles of brushwood. On both sides of the fighting, the Jin used the counterweight trebuchet against the Taihang strongholds built into the mountains, while the volunteers in the hills answered with levers and hide slings of their own making, and even with stones hurled by hand, to withstand the distant bombardment. At Shunchang the Jin still brought throwing engines and battering rams to the assault, and Liu Qi's garrison replied with thundering bombs, poisoned arrows and long spears, and with smoke and noise thrown into the enemy's ranks.
tactics: 八字軍的戰術本質是敵後游擊而非會戰。依仗太行山諸谷與山口的險峻，它們白天潛伏在山寨與村寨之間，夜晚分隊出擊，破壞金軍的糧道、驛傳與屯田，收護被擄走的鄉民；遇金軍大隊便散入山峪、結寨自守，逼迫金軍分兵掃蕩，用拉長的戰線拖垮敵方銳氣。大會戰並非它的長項：建炎元年九月北渡黃河的首戰便因敵眾我寡而大敗，隊伍在敗退中吸納沿途百姓與散兵，才重新聚起。與宋軍配合時採取古法：宋師在正面吸引金人注意，義軍出太行、斷其糧草、焚其輜重，再退入山區。招安之後，部分原義軍被編為官軍，開始使用制式弓弩、硬弓與長槍，並配置壘石、拒馬、鹿角；金軍則以鐵騎為核心，輔以連環馬與輕裝騎兵繞行側翼。順昌之戰是這種配合的高峰：劉錫以少量精兵據守城池，弓弩與霹靂炮壓制敵陣，並派部將抄擊金軍營寨側背，使金軍的攻城器械失去掩護，聯軍當即崩潰。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Eight-Character Army were essentially those of a guerrilla war behind enemy lines, not of a set-piece battle. Sheltered by the ravines and passes of the Taihang Mountains, they lay hidden by day in the strongholds and villages along the range, broke out in small parties by night to destroy Jin supply lines, courier stations and garrison farms and to recover villagers carried off into slavery; when a large Jin column appeared they dispersed into the gullies, fortified their own stockades and forced the enemy to split its forces into sweeping columns, wearing down the enemy's sharpness with a front that stretched further and further. Large set-piece battles were not their strength: the first crossing of the Yellow River in the ninth month of Jianyan 1 ended in a crushing defeat because they were outnumbered, and only while retreating did the force absorb refugees and stragglers along the road and re-form. When cooperating with the Song army they followed an old pattern: the regular army drew the Jin's attention in the front, while the volunteers struck out of the Taihang range to cut the enemy's supply, burn his baggage and then withdrew into the hills. After the pacification, part of the old guerrilla force was enrolled as regular troops and began to use standard crossbows, stiff bows and long spears together with piled stones, cheval-de-frise and antler obstacles; the Jin in turn built on iron cavalry, reinforced by linked horse formations and light mounted columns that worked around the flanks. The battle of Shunchang was the high point of this combination: Liu Qi held the city with a small body of picked men, bows and thundering bombs pinning the enemy array, and sent officers to strike the side and rear of the Jin camp so that their siege engines lost cover, whereupon the allied force collapsed.
data: 可考可查的數字有限，但仍有幾個樞紐。建炎元年（1127）九月，張所命王彥率岳飛等七千人北渡黃河，這是八字軍由民間武裝轉為戰役力量的起點，人數只有七千。渡河初戰敗後，義軍在燕雲十六州與河北各州縣迅速擴張，一度超過十萬人，這既是這支部隊的鼎盛規模，也是它後來無法再靠劫掠與募兵維持的原因之一。建炎二年冬，王彥部一度進取燕京，得手而未能立足，全軍旋即潰散，反映義軍缺乏攻城與守城的能力。順昌之戰（紹興十年，1140）是最常被引用的數據：劉錫率約五千名守軍，頂住完顏宗弼所率十萬餘金軍的輪番攻城，圍城攻擊歷十餘日而不能下，戰後金軍損失以萬計，棄甲兵、被擄者甚多。另一端，八字之名本身就是數據：面刺「赤心報國，誓殺金賊」八個字，一支沒有軍籍、沒有糧餉的隊伍，就此有了名號與號召力。
dataEn: The figures that can be verified are few, but there are several key ones. In the ninth month of Jianyan 1 (1127) Zhang Suo ordered Wang Yan to take Yue Fei and seven thousand men north across the Yellow River; this was the point at which the Eight-Character Army moved from being a civic armed body to a force in the war, and the number of men was only seven thousand. After the defeat at the crossing, the volunteers expanded rapidly through the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun and the prefectures of Hebei, at one point exceeding one hundred thousand men; that was both the high-water mark of the force and the reason why it could no longer sustain itself on plunder and recruitment alone. In the winter of Jianyan 2 (1128) Wang Yan's troops entered Yanjing for a time, but could not hold what they had taken and the host dissolved almost at once, which shows the volunteers' lack of both siege and defensive capacity. The battle of Shunchang (Shaoxing 10, 1140) is the most frequently cited set of numbers: Liu Qi with about five thousand defenders held off repeated assaults by more than one hundred thousand Jin troops under Wanyan Zongbi; the siege dragged on for more than ten days without the city falling, and afterwards the Jin lost men in the thousands, abandoning armour and weapons and leaving many prisoners behind. At the other end of the record, the name itself is data: eight tattooed characters, '赤心報國，誓殺金賊', were enough to give an army without pay-chests or rations a title and a rallying cry.
cause: 直接導火線是靖康之變。靖康二年（1127）正月金軍攻陷汴京，北宋皇室覆亡；四月徽宗、欽宗二帝被挾北上，北宋的文武百官、宗室、匠戶與宮人隨之被擄走，河北、山東、中原陷入無政府狀態。金人依《海上之盟》取得燕雲十六州後，把河北變成騎兵後方，強制推行女真制度的同時，維持地方秩序的宋軍與官府全部崩解，剩下的是難以忍受的徵斂、擄掠與徵兵。在這樣的真空裡，河北的漢人農民、獵戶、逃戶、殘兵與被金人收編的漢人軍戶各自武裝起來，以面刺八字的方式立誓，組成義軍。靖康之變同時摧毀了北宋原有的軍事框架，讓北方出現大量手持武器而無軍籍的武裝；這些武裝既懼怕金軍的鐵騎，也懷疑南渡朝廷是否真能收復失地。八字軍正是在這樣的雙重不信任中形成，並在趙構南渡、朝廷鞭長莫及的空白地帶生長出來。
causeEn: The direct trigger was the Jingkang disaster. In the first month of Jingkang 2 (1127) the Jin army took Bianjing and the Northern Song royal house fell; in the fourth month the emperors Huizong and Qinzong were carried off north, and the officials, the imperial clan, the craftsmen and the palace households of the Northern Song went with them, leaving Hebei, Shandong and the central plain without government. Having taken the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun under the Maritime Covenant, the Jin turned Hebei into the rear of their cavalry and imposed the Jurchen system, while every Song command and office that had kept local order fell apart, leaving behind exactions, slave-taking and conscription that the population could not endure. Into that vacuum the Han peasants, hunters, deserters, survivors of the Song army and the Han military households enrolled by the Jin armed themselves and formed bands, swearing themselves in by tattooing the eight characters on their faces. The Jingkang disaster also destroyed the military framework of the Northern Song, leaving the north full of armed men without military registers; these men feared the Jin cavalry and simultaneously doubted whether the court that had fled south would ever truly recover the lost lands. The Eight-Character Army grew out of that double distrust, in the blank spaces that the Southern Song, once it had moved south, could not reach.
impact: 八字軍最大的歷史影響，是把敵後抗金變成南宋可以倚重的戰略。宗澤、張所、張俊、劉錫到岳飛，都曾把河北的民間武裝視為北方戰線的支撐；岳飛北伐計畫中的連結河朔、官民配合，正是要借重這套網絡，這一思路後來成為南宋前期對金作戰的特徵之一。另一面的影響來自它自身的失敗：招安只給了名義上的官軍身份，沒有給糧餉與補充，多數義軍在戰鬥中消耗、在勝利中瓦解，演變成河北大大小小的山寨武裝與盜匪，朝廷屢次招安、潰散、再招安，既消耗了西線與南線的兵力，也令北方局勢長期無法整合。到紹興年間，以八字軍為名的只剩下零星數支，多數官兵化，戰役規模與影響力都大不如前。八字軍因此既是南宋初年唯一的北方主力，也證明了失去的北方若無騎兵與糧道，再壯的民兵也守不住。
impactEn: The greatest historical impact of the Eight-Character Army was turning resistance behind enemy lines into a strategy the Southern Song could rely on. Zong Ze, Zhang Suo, Zhang Jun, Liu Qi and finally Yue Fei all treated the civilian armed bands of Hebei as the prop of the northern front; the plan of Yue Fei's northern campaign, to link up with the peoples of Hebei and to coordinate regular troops with irregulars, was built precisely on this network, and that way of thinking became one of the characteristic features of Song warfare against Jin in the early Southern Song. The other side of the impact came from the army's own failure. Pacification granted a nominal military status but no pay, rations or reinforcement; most of the volunteers were spent in battle or dissolved in victory, turning into the innumerable mountain strongholds and bandit bands of Hebei, and the court's repeated cycle of pacification, dispersal and renewed pacification drained troops from the western and southern fronts and left the northern situation permanently unintegrated. By the Shaoxing years only a handful of units still bore the name of the Eight-Character Army, most of them turned regular, their scale and influence greatly reduced. The Eight-Character Army was thus both the only real northern force of the early Southern Song and the proof that, without cavalry and supply lines, the north once lost could not be held by any militia however large.
result: 結局是敗退與分裂，而不是一場決定性的勝利。建炎元年北渡黃河的首戰大敗，說明八字軍靠的是面刺八字的士氣，而不是攻城器械與騎兵，這也是它在配重投石車、撞車、鐵騎俱全的金軍面前始終居於劣勢的根本原因。建炎二年張所被罷、招撫司裁撤後，八字軍失去統一指揮；同年宗澤病逝，南宋在河北的官軍網中斷，義軍各部或被收編、或淪為游勇。一部分隨岳飛成為岳家軍的骨幹，經建康、襄漢之戰一路打到北伐郾城與朱仙鎮；一部分隨劉錫在順昌以弱勝強；更多數散在太行山與河北平原，化為難以清除的武裝集團。紹興和議最終以淮水為界，宋金南北分治，八字軍所指望的恢復中原並未實現，但這支部隊在靖康之後最黑暗的十幾年裡，保住了河北一線的抵抗火種，也留下一種此前中原王朝沒有的作戰樣式：以山區為巢、以面刺為誓、以游擊拖住敵軍。
resultEn: The outcome was a withdrawal and a fragmentation, not a decisive victory. The defeat of the first crossing of the Yellow River in Jianyan 1 showed that what the Eight-Character Army had was the morale born of eight tattooed characters, not siege engines or cavalry; that was the root reason why it remained at a disadvantage before a Jin army that possessed counterweight trebuchets, battering rams and iron cavalry alike. After Zhang Suo was dismissed and the recruitment office abolished in Jianyan 2, the Eight-Character Army lost any unified command, and in the same year Zong Ze died of illness, cutting the chain of Song officers in Hebei; the various bands were now either enrolled into the regular army or turned into roving bands of outlaws. Some followed Yue Fei and became the backbone of the Yue family army, carrying the war from the fighting at Jiankang and Xiangyang to the victories at Yancheng and Zhuxian Town during the northern campaign; some followed Liu Qi to win at Shunchang against far superior numbers; and many more scattered through the Taihang range and the plains of Hebei, becoming armed bands that were very hard to eliminate. The Shaoxing peace settlement finally fixed the Huai River as the frontier between Song and Jin, and the restoration of the central plain that the Eight-Character Army had hoped for never came; but through the darkest dozen years after Jingkang this force kept alive the spark of resistance in Hebei, and it left behind a form of warfare the central plain dynasties had not known before: nesting in the mountains, swearing the oath on the skin, and wearing the enemy down by guerrilla war.
